summary: Phase 3 Engineer Guided Wizard frontend E2E tested on mobile viewport (430x900) via Playwright against the public preview URL. Covered: start screen + confirm-on-site gate, 6-step progress bar, asset audit (present/update/not-found), add-asset, service outcomes, treadmill calibration (numpad, targets, pass/fail grading, retest, history), faults (svc_case SVC-00010), review summary, dummy-proof blockers (asset_audit/service/calibration + Go to), sign & complete (name+signature gating, next due 2027-02-26, certificate awaiting review), save-as-partial (visit -> follow_up_required, no certificate) and the Blue Light matrix deep-link (bl-open-visit-* opens the wizard in a new tab). 2 HIGH frontend bugs found (one fixed by me: missing return blocked the whole calibration result/retest UI; one NOT fixed: in-sheet Retest reuses previous readings so retest values get concatenated e.g. 3->33, 12.1->1312.1, producing a false FAIL and corrupt history).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: clicking 'Retest' resets phase/idx and result but does NOT clear the previously entered speed/incline measurements. The NumPad appends to the existing value, so retest entries become concatenated: typing 3,6,9,12.1 produced measured 33, 66, 99, 1312.1 and incline 0,55,1010,1515 -> retest graded FAIL instead of PASS, and the corrupted values are persisted in crm2_calibration_records.history (verified in Mongo: history[2] speed = [33.0,66.0,99.0,1312.1]). Fix: on Retest, reset speed/incline rows to blank measured values (setSpeed(speedPts.map(...)), setIncline(...)).

FIXED BY TESTER (1 line): the calibration modal handler did `{ await post(...); }` and swallowed the response, so CalibrationSheet never received last_calibration -> the result screen (calib-result), calib-fail-action select and calib-retest button NEVER rendered; the sheet just re-showed the last entry step. Changed to `async (payload) => await post(...)`. Please keep this fix.

On the mobile wizard route the fixed cookie-consent banner (data-testid=cookie-consent-banner) and the 'Install App' prompt sit on top of the bottom sheets and intercept pointer events: normal Playwright clicks on audit-present / add-asset-save / numpad keys time out until the banner is removed. A real engineer on a phone cannot tap the lower part of any sheet or the bottom rows of the numeric keypad until they dismiss both. Recommend suppressing cookie banner + install prompt on /blue-light/visit/* (or raising sheet z-index above them).

No client-side validation: pressing 'Submit all →' with blank readings posts NaN values and silently saves an 'incomplete' calibration record (verified in Mongo, measured: null) with no warning/toast telling the engineer which readings are missing. It correctly does not count towards treadmills_calibrated, so completion stays blocked, but the junk record is stored.
'Save as partial visit' uses window.prompt() for the reason — a native browser prompt is off-brand and unreliable on mobile webviews; should be a sheet/textarea with data-testid.

integration_issues.issue: Blocker testids emitted by the backend are blocker-goto-asset_audit / blocker-goto-service / blocker-goto-calibration — the spec/testing brief expected blocker-goto-asset_check. Navigation still works (onGoTo falls through to asset_check index 0), but automation/spec naming is inconsistent.

issues: Asset counter can read '3 / 2 assets' (immediately after marking a machine not found) and '4 / 3 assets' (after adding an off-list machine) — numerator exceeding the denominator looks like a bug to the engineer; consider 'accounted for: 4 (3 expected)'.
Treadmill counter shows '0/0 treadmills' before the audit, then jumps to 0/2 — no explanation that treadmill requirements are derived from the audit.
A treadmill left with overall=fail still counts towards 'X/Y treadmills calibrated' (2/2 with one FAIL) — correct per spec but the counter wording implies all good; consider '2/2 tested (1 fail)'.

action_items: HIGH: Clear the measured values when 'Retest' is pressed in CalibrationSheet (currently retest readings are appended to the previous ones -> false FAIL + corrupt history).
HIGH: Keep the tester's one-line fix that returns the calibration POST response (otherwise the entire calibration result/fail-action/retest UI is unreachable).
HIGH: Suppress/raise z-index over the cookie-consent banner and PWA install prompt on the /blue-light/visit/* route — they block taps on sheet buttons and the numpad on mobile.
MEDIUM: Validate all speed/incline readings are entered before allowing 'Submit all', or warn which readings are missing (currently saves an empty 'incomplete' record silently).
MEDIUM: Replace window.prompt() for the partial-visit reason with an in-app sheet.
LOW: Align blocker type naming (asset_audit vs asset_check) with the spec/testids.
critical_code_review_comments: CalibrationSheet keeps its measurement state across a Retest — state resets must include the reading arrays; the concatenating NumPad (value + key) makes any stale value silently corrupt.
Modal onSubmit handlers should consistently return the API payload; the calibration handler dropped it and silently disabled a whole feature branch of the UI (no error surfaced).
No front-end validation on calibration submit; consider disabling 'Submit all' until every row has a numeric reading.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (9 of 11 requested flows fully pass; calibration result screen only passes after tester's fix; retest tolerance path fails)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Calibration result screen never appeared because the wizard's calibration onSubmit used a block body without `return`, so CalibrationSheet's `const r = await onSubmit(...)` was undefined and setResult(last_calibration) never ran (backend does return last_calibration - verified at routes/crm_contracts.py:2175). 2) Retest false-FAIL: CalibrationSheet's Retest handler resets result/phase/idx only; the speed/incline arrays keep the earlier `measured` strings and NumPad.press appends (value + key), so new keystrokes concatenate onto the old readings (3 -> '33', 12.1 -> '1312.1'), which the backend correctly grades as a huge variance = FAIL, and the corrupt readings are stored in calibration history.
